title: Gospel Compare
image_text: Read the four Gospels side by side, event by event.
caption: How do Matthew, Mark, Luke and John each tell the same moment in Jesus' life? Gospel Compare lays the accounts next to each other, so you can read them together and notice the details each writer includes.

title: AI Explore
image_text: Ask about the people, places and topics of the Bible.
caption: Curious about a Bible character, a city, or a theme? AI Explore helps you start digging. Always read the Scripture passages for yourself, too.

title: Bible Battle
image_text: Challenge another player to a 1v1 Bible quiz.
caption: Learning God's Word can be fun with friends. Bible Battle matches you with another player for a head-to-head Bible quiz.

title: Daily Verse
image_text: A verse of encouragement for every day.
caption: Start each day with a word from Scripture. Open the app to find today's verse waiting for you on the Explore screen.

title: Bible Notes
image_text: Keep your own notes as you study God's Word.
caption: Write down what you are learning, questions to come back to, and verses that speak to you, all in one place inside the app.

title: Bible Dictionary
image_text: Look up the people, places and words of the Bible.
caption: Come across a name or word you don't recognise? Look it up in Easton's Bible Dictionary, right inside the app.

title: Cross References
image_text: Follow a verse to related passages across the Bible.
caption: Scripture helps explain Scripture. Long-press a verse in the Bible reader to open its cross references and the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, where available.
how_to_find: Bible → long-press a verse → Cross Reference / TSK

title: Compare Translations
image_text: See a verse side by side in different Bible versions.
caption: Reading a verse in more than one translation can open up its meaning. Download the versions you want, then long-press any verse and tap Compare.

title: Prayer Wall
image_text: Share prayer requests and pray for one another.
caption: "Bear ye one another's burdens" (Galatians 6:2, KJV). Share a prayer request with the community, and take a moment to pray for others.

title: Bible Courses
image_text: Learn step by step with guided Bible courses.
caption: Go deeper with structured Bible courses you can follow at your own pace, and receive a certificate when you complete one.

title: Bible Quizzes
image_text: Test what you've learned with Bible quizzes.
caption: Check your Bible knowledge with quizzes, see your score, and review your answers to learn more each time.

title: Daily Devotionals
image_text: A short devotional to reflect on each day.
caption: Take a quiet moment with a devotional reading and let it shape your prayer and your day.

title: Bookmarks
image_text: Save the verses that matter to you, in your own categories.
caption: Keep the verses you want to return to. Bookmark them into your own categories and find them again any time.

title: Comfortable Reading
image_text: Choose your theme, text size and layout for easy reading.
caption: Read the Bible the way that suits your eyes: light or dark theme, larger text, and a layout that feels right for you.

title: Jesus, I Come to You
image_text: Lord Jesus, I know that I am a sinner and I need Your forgiveness. I believe You died for my sins and rose from the dead. I turn from my sins and invite You into my life as my Lord and Saviour. Thank You for the gift of eternal life. Amen.
caption:
"That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved." (Romans 10:9, KJV)

Salvation is not something we earn. It is God's gift, received by faith in Jesus Christ. You can talk to Him right now, in your own words or with the prayer above.

If you prayed this today, you have taken a first step. Tell someone you trust, find a Bible-believing church near you, and start reading the Gospel of John.

title: God So Loved You
image_text: Father, thank You for loving me so much that You gave Your only Son. I believe in Jesus. I receive Your forgiveness and the everlasting life You promise. Help me to follow You every day. In Jesus' name, Amen.
caption:
"For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life." (John 3:16, KJV)

"Whosoever" includes you. God's love is not earned; it is given.

If you prayed this today, you have taken a first step. Tell someone you trust, find a Bible-believing church near you, and start reading the Gospel of John.

title: Saved by Grace
image_text: Lord, I cannot save myself. I trust not in my own good works but in Your grace alone. Thank You that Jesus paid for my sin on the cross. I receive Your gift of salvation by faith. Amen.
caption:
"For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast." (Ephesians 2:8-9, KJV)

We are not saved by trying harder, but by trusting Jesus.

If you prayed this today, you have taken a first step. Tell someone you trust, find a Bible-believing church near you, and start reading the Gospel of John.

title: He Stands at the Door
image_text: Lord Jesus, I hear You knocking. I open the door of my heart to You. Come in and be my Saviour and Lord. Forgive my sins and make me new. Amen.
caption:
"Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me." (Revelation 3:20, KJV)

Jesus invites; He does not force. The door is opened from the inside.

If you prayed this today, you have taken a first step. Tell someone you trust, find a Bible-believing church near you, and start reading the Gospel of John.

title: Forgiven and Made Clean
image_text: Father, I confess my sins to You. Thank You that You are faithful and just to forgive me and to cleanse me from all unrighteousness through Jesus Christ. I give my life to You. Amen.
caption:
"If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness." (1 John 1:9, KJV)

No sin is too great for God's forgiveness in Christ.

If you prayed this today, you have taken a first step. Tell someone you trust, find a Bible-believing church near you, and start reading the Gospel of John.

title: The Way, the Truth, the Life
image_text: Jesus, You are the way, the truth, and the life. I come to the Father through You. I believe You died for me and rose again. Lead me in Your truth all my days. Amen.
caption:
"Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me." (John 14:6, KJV)

The way to God is not a set of rules but a Person: Jesus Christ.

If you prayed this today, you have taken a first step. Tell someone you trust, find a Bible-believing church near you, and start reading the Gospel of John.
